department: Center for Molecular and Behavioral Neuroscience (CMBN)

deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications are due December 15, 2026 for both U.S. and non-U.S. applicants.

also.quote: Applications are due December 15th every year.

gre_general.value: Submitting a recent GRE General result is optional.
gre_general.quote: A recent GRE result can also be submitted, but is optional.

gre_subject.value: The CMBN Graduate Program in Neuroscience pages do not state a GRE Subject Test policy.

supervisor.value: The CMBN Graduate Program in Neuroscience pages do not explicitly state whether prior faculty advisor contact or agreement is required before admission.

funding.value: All admitted Ph.D. students, regardless of nationality, receive a 12-month renewable graduate assistantship ($40,635), tuition remission, and medical benefits for the full 5 years.
funding.quote: All admitted students, regardless of nationality, receive a 12-month renewable graduate assistantship of $40,635, plus tuition remission and a medical benefits plan. This funding support is provided for the full 5 years of the program, contingent on maintaining good academic standing.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or equivalent with a B average or better is required to enter the program.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree or equivalent from a recognized institution of higher education in the United States or abroad is required to enter the program; in general, a B average or better is expected.

notes: Rutgers-Newark's Department of Psychology Ph.D. also includes a Neuroscience training area (sasn.rutgers.edu/graduate-training-neuroscience) alongside CMBN's dedicated Ph.D. in Neuroscience.
name: Ph.D. in Neuroscience (Graduate Program in Neuroscience)
